disclosure.selection_disclosure: This polygon was introduced after the initial V4 mask design. Its x=725 boundary is deliberately adjacent to the half-open corridor x=[694,725), so zero overlap is a construction property, not independent validation.

registered_tan_bump_probe.policy: Label this tan source-texture bump in 1x/3x evidence so it is not silently reclassified as residual sclera or authored waterline. Human review decides its anatomy.

recommended_variant.name: feather_2px
recommended_variant.basis: At native and Phase36 playback-scale/3x still review, V3 hard retains the pale endpoint, extended hard terminates abruptly, and 1px retains a small seam. The 2px registered-source profile is smoothest, with locked 85/85 maximum alpha steps. The registered tan bump [722,275] and adjacent x=719..724 endpoint remain explicitly human-adjudicated; this is not rebuild authorization.
